name: describe_type
description:
Read a Type from the platform: its .type declaration, its existing
    Type.py implementation, its object ids, and the runtimes methods may claim.

name: get_obj
description: Fetch one object of a Type from the platform, with all its fields.

name: test_method
description:
Test a generated method on a real object, in the runtime it claims.

    The object is fetched from the platform here, with the connection
    credential, and passed in as data: the sandbox itself has no network and
    no credentials. Returns the method's value, timing, and convention checks.

type_name.description: Type the method belongs to, e.g. WindTurbine.

obj_id.description: Real object to test on, e.g. TURBINE-014.

implementation.description: Full source of the Type.py implementation file.

method.description: Name of the method (top-level function) to call.

runtime_name.description: Runtime the method claims, e.g. py-contoso-analytics.

args_json.description: JSON object of keyword arguments, e.g. {"window": 24}.

name: run_in_runtime
description: Execute Python in a sandboxed platform runtime (an isolated session, no egress).

code.description: Python source to execute. Use print() to produce output.

runtime_name.description: Runtime name, e.g. py-contoso-analytics or py-generic.

name: describe_execution_context
description:
Report what executed code can actually see: secrets, identity, network.

    'in_process' runs the probe inside the agent process, the way a harness
    that exec()s model-written code would. 'sandboxed' runs the identical probe
    in the default runtime's session pool. Compare the two.

name: load_skill
description: Load the current default version of a Foundry skill: its full instructions.

name.description: Skill name from the SKILLS list
